_comment: Llama-line v2 experiment (2026-09-17, user ruling): RPBE + comp JOINT training from the OFFICIAL merged model (Step-1 foundation merged + released Step-2 merge_recur adapter + trainable SeparatedEmbedding comp rows + Gamma). 60 windows, checkpoint every 10, protocol A (val+test pooled) evaluation.  The R10 frozen_method.json stays untouched.

backbone.model: llama-7b (original LLaMA-7B) + Step-1 llama-7b-no MERGED + released Step-2 adapter llama-7b-no-online-merge_recur-ntok2
backbone.comp_trainable: true (official SeparatedEmbedding semantics; comp rows train alongside Gamma — the JOINT experiment; task gradients update LoRA+comp, RPBE updates Gamma only under rpbe_gamma_only)

lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: R10 value kept (user ruling 2026-09-18).  The joint-theta_0 recalibration returned r_eff_gamma=16.844 -> 0.005937 (diff ~3e-9 from this value); the R10 constant is authoritative for the joint run.

training.steps_note: Extended to 100 windows (user ruling 2026-09-18): resume from the s60 checkpoint of the RPBE+comp joint run (checkpoint_step60.pt carries optimizer/scheduler state).

sampling.rule: R10 depth-stratified protocol (inverse-sqrt weights + 3x cap, one dialogue per window) — unchanged for the llama line
